verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS design platform like Figma, but the evidence pack has no documentation of retention policies, data deletion controls, or AI data-handling settings. Related items do not transfer to this story: the Variables API can delete design variables, version history can be viewed, and SCIM handles role offboarding, but none of these let a user control how long data is kept or delete it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
